title: Explicit restricted augmented-total map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. Define $a_q:\sigma_{\ge q}K\to R_q$ using the component maps [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-total-construction] and their differential-commutation property [lem-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-augmentation-comm]. All component data are explicit.
